name: chrysaki-mcp
description: An MCP panel in the Chrysaki look: each server, its tools and a key to turn it on or off, with on-demand servers that start off in every session

onDemand.title: On-demand servers
onDemand.description: MCP server names, separated by commas. The mod turns each one off at the start of every session. Turn one on in /mcp-panel when you need it
